text: It's basically white out, but with extras, so it's more fun. And zombies, like cheese, make everything better. It's all about the fire again, but this time it's protection from zombies, and the use of resouces is more reasonable. There's the hero battles for extra resources and speed up, etc. And the alliance battles and mission map like the mysterious island game (that i got sick of shortly after discovering there was no way to progress past a certain point without paying).

--First hand review from an ex player-- I have played the game for about a year. Not sure why this is classed as top games that are free to play. There is a TON of micro transactions and honestly if you don't, you will always be behind. Even mid spenders. Game is full of bugs that they will refuse to acknowledge or compensate properly. Changes made to encourage micro transactions and some are exploitative. This game isn't what it used to be. Save yourself time and money-- avoid.

If you enjoy the type of base building that take minuets to hours to days etc. etc then this is the game for you. You'll find lots of people to talk to and some who will try to scam. Onto the nitty gritty bit, the game can be played without any cost, you don't have to pay to play but if you want to do *well* in the game you with need to spend money to keep up with others and the constant "You should buy this" it is a very much a pay to win game.

the game is not what it mentioned in the ads or even the images provided. it's basically, a top view game like other games. buildings need to be builder in the designated spaces itself, and mini games like boss fight and all. I expected a game what was shown in the image, thought about having a space and collecting stuff and gradually making it into post apocalypse shelter. and in ads you people where showing like we can stay in a train and developing inside that train and nothing like that.

Dark War Survival is fun for the first week while your beginner shield is active. Once it drops, higher-level players repeatedly attack you and wipe out your resources. Progress becomes painfully slow and the gameplay turns repetitive. It feels less about strategy and more about spending real money to stay competitive and avoid constant losses. What starts as a fun game quickly becomes frustrating unless you're willing to pay.

New update has made it unplayable. My troops are stuck in limbo, I can't access them. Ruin tasks still not accessible either. Edit: Troop issue fixed, but no access to ruin tasks still. The newest Season has been a nightmare - I appreciate that things needed to change, but this has not been fun and ramped up the pay to play element significantly.

thank you so much for slamming the maintenance thing on the day with both bio mutant and zombie waves. so thats around 35M to 45M worth of resources that you devs now owe us when we are able to relog back into the game. you guys are making white out look better to play at this rate. and when that day comes im getting a full refund on everything I've bought in this game just to put into the other game. as this is one too many times you devs have F'd up

Absolutely terrible game. I am fully aware that the ads used AI, and I didn't really expect much from the game either, but the game is nowhere near what the ads are. This is blatant false advertising. you don't get to choose a shelter you are literally put in Forest and given the exact same start and progression has any other user would get, I am vastly disappointed😕

Misleading ads - If you are looking to download and play this game based on ads you have seen or the pictures on this site - don't. The game is nothing like what has been shown in the adverts - it doesn't even come close. If it was, I am sure I would've loved it but the game you start playing is not anything different from others where you upgrade, train heroes and fight bosses, same mechanics as others, same old, same old. not my cup of tea. It's a real shame, had such high hopes for this one.

Are these reviews fake. Seeing the ad on Facebook I downloaded the game, nothing like the ad. I don't play much, but this is a world building game. I say game but you're just tapping areas on the screen and hoping for the best. You build rooms, you're team kills zombies or dies, you don't really do much there. You join rallies with others to kill zombies. You grow your village by killing and building, That's about it. Not sure how this is a game when most of the work is done for you

Another game not matching the screenshots posted. The story and character designs are nice, but as you progress through the game, it unlocks social aspects (e.g. chat, alliance) and pay options. The images promise a dark/grittier game but as another reviewer mentioned, the gameplay itself is like Whiteout which is fun in itself but the P2W option just isn't for me.

could be a good game but player griefing and broke mechanics. I had played it for a week or so, built up my troops (takes time to build an army) and spent time gathering resources. during the night, my shelter was attacked more than 10 times by a single player, all my troops and resources I had spent weeks building gone, and my shelter destroyed. why is this even a game mechanic? why can a single player continue to attack your shelter without any time delay?

Changing my review because this new season has been a total let down so far. The Devs keep changing the goal posts with every update. Near enough everything is having to cost money and to get anything to hit targets hitting zombies etc is near on impossible after a certain point. This game used to be fun, now it's just a money making machine for the Devs with unrealistic expectations.

This is good, but it could definitely be better. Developers, I genuinely love this game and appreciate the effort that has gone into it. However, I’d really like to understand something. Why give us bells to ring to alert survivors to gather at the lighthouse tower and avoid the zombies, if the AI isn’t responsive enough to actually react to it? The zombies come in to attack. I ring the bell to warn everyone and try to regroup but the survivors completely ignore it saying is this a false alarm?

Update: I reached out to their support and it was fixed right away. I'm glad because it is an enjoyable game. fun game but it only lets you get so far before it bugs. I have tried multiple times to pass the fighter camp. I get past the first set of enemies only to go into another area where nothing happens. I don't normally spend money on games but I was enjoying this one but I can't progress anymore.

The game is nothing like the ads: I wanted this base survial game, where I actually feel threatened, and want to build up my special hideout. This game is a lie! But if you want a readaptation of Whiteout survival that is more realistic than polar bears attacking you, this is the game for you; it is nothing like the ads: you don't look for your own unique base, the zombies are not the same, and your base upgrading is just nothing in similarity. I will repeat this game is a lie!

Not like the advert. The advert shows a much better and more enjoyable game than the actual one you can play. The adverts are lies, not just misleading, absolute bare faced 100% total lies. The game isn't a solo survivor choosing a camp location then adding engines to making it mobile, it's managing a predetermined village in a zombie forest. Literally couldn't be less like the adverts. 100% lies. 0/10 do not recommend. Avoid.

been playing it about 10 minutes. I like it. just waiting for the notification I must buy a service fee in order to keep playing it. at that point I'll delete it. if it ends up being like boom Beach. then I would definitely keep playing it. in boom Beach you can buy things to make it easier but you don't have to it'll just take longer to upgrade things. and after 11 years I'm still playing that one.

I played this game every day for a couple hours for 184 days straight. idk what ad you saw before reading this but this game is NOT a game about gathering survivors and finding peace after the apocalypse. this game is a p2w always online mobile multiplayer war game. for that, it's very good. tons of addictive content and you CAN compete albeit at a slightly lower level while spending less ($100/month is viable if you're very smart). the top players spend thousands.

So its an MMO. So far I've learned if you wan SR or SSR characters you basically need to BUY into the game. There is NO customizations. Ok story. Forced tutorial. Skipping scenes doesn't skip the entire scene. You have no free build, you're forced where buildings are set. And the "fighting" is forced by other players as the zombies that come in about every 2 mins or so, you don't get to kill some rando character does and you have no control over anything.

At the start, the game is manageable as a solo player, but as you begin to really progress, you'll have to join a good clan as a lot of the in-game events are clan-focused. The purchases aren't always too expensive (but some are) and you don't need them to progress (unless you're impatient of course) Overall, a good, well balanced game, available only ONLINE of course.

The ads are misleading. Even the photos on this page do not honestly represent the gameplay. The game itself is okay; just your average castle and clan type game. Not my cup of tea. I honestly wouldn't have downloaded if it weren't for the misleading ads and promo art. The game would have gotten 4 stars but making me think it was a different game? Yeah, zero stars.

Game reloads frequently. S Tier heroes are the strongest and impossible to get through normal gameplay - you're almost forced to buy them or get crushed without it. There is no balance on who you can attack... Low level players (level 10) always get raided by level 22+ players. You can upgrade 1 building at a time or buy another for 24hrs with gems. If there is not enough time remaining to complete your next building, you forfeit the remaining time instead of having the option to extend.

I have been playing this game for several months. I enjoy some of the aspects of the game. However, I much rather play solo than under an Alliance group. There is way too much toxic players in the game, people arguing, rebelling and constantly quitting. Especially the Leaders in the game who then constantly reassigning the next person to take their place as the Leader. This whole game needs to be rebuilt for people who want to "Solo Play".

First off, there are no ads at all. That by itself gets it three stars. Overall this was a decent enough game until it started adding more and more convulted minigames that I'm not particularly interested in. The alliance system is an absolute mess and i wish the game would stop forcing it on me. If they just stuck to the basics, it would have been much better.

STOP USING AI ADS. If this game was actually anything like the ads, I would have LOVED it. However, its not even close. I expected a cute, cozy, aesthetic post apocolyptic style build game. Its a totally pointless game and not a unique concept in anyway, recruit heroes, fight zombies and upgrade facilities. Complete with bouncing catgirl t!tties. please just use ads that correctly depict the game so people know what theyre actually going to be playing. Please develop the game shown in the ad 😭

I played game after game after game, from fashion to horror, horse to fish. Each game has similar aspects, and this game is no different. Virtually every survival game is the same, with limited differences. However, it doesn't make this game any less entertaining for the choice of F2P or not. It's graphically pleasing to the eye with a comical twist to incorporate hero battles. 4 stars.

Super cute horrible bugs, can't load profile pics even after purchasing the pack, you choose from gallery and boots you out of the app everytime( all permissions are given. It glitches out after three mins of playing because the servers are unstable, the ingame system chat just throws the prompt at you over and over and never fixes the issue. Heavy heavy play to win

At first I enjoyed the game since it's not pressuring me to always be active in the game since I have a life of being busy. But as the game progresses especially with the release of S2 and now S3, it's just so off putting how the game is giving you a middle finger especially if you're mostly free-to-play. The fact that the devs just reheated their ideas for S2 to be done on S3 and it's pretty much the whales progressing faster, ones who can afford most of the overpriced content

It's a great game. The things I would add are the ability to transfer accounts from one server to another and the ability to transfer resources to alliance members who need them. There shouldn't be a maximum level in the game because if you reach the maximum level, there's no room for improvement in your base, let alone your alliance. I think there should be a reward system in place once you reach a certain level, like an alliance expansion to 50 players and up it every 10 levels.

4/18 I've been enjoying the game but once again there are issues that have made the game unplayable. This time it won't load past 2%. Been this way all day. For Ed closed, cleared cache, reinstalled. Nothing. Support has been no help at all. 4/19 tried yet another reinstall and same issue. I'm done. Uninstalled.

VERY FRUSTRATING Multiple players are experiencing difficulty with the translator taking 1-2mins to load one message in a foreign language but if anyone else posts in the chat it starts over again. Also, with in game notifications, they keep wiping everyone's typed out messages before we get to send them and have to type them out again. Events for watchtower skins relies on donations or gifts from others so no matter how much you pay into it, you have low chance of getting the skin. Scam.

The reason i only gave 4 stars is because there's a fundamental lack of a trade system. I want to be able to trade gear/resources with my alliance members. And things like photos and hero upgrade pieces should be able to be traded in for higher quality items. The game doesn't require you to spend money at all though so its still 4 stars

This gane is fun for the first few levels. After "Season" 2 or 3, the servers turn exclusively pay to win. If you want a second job that costs you money and punishes you for taking time off, this is the game for you.

the game itself isn't that bad, but literally the only truthful things in any of the ads is you're building a base, but you don't get to choose the location or anything, or what it looks like, all of them are the same with one central light tower, dorms on the right and harvest buildings on the left with very little customization, and that's only to the lightower, that's why I have to give it a low rating, false advertising, would have been better if they just marketed the actual game instead.

The game has a lot of potential, and I've enjoyed it for the past 8 months. Unfortunately, it heavily caters to whales. Max-level players can repeatedly target and wipe out newer players, and unless you have gems for shields (often requiring real money), there's nothing you can do. I suggested level-based protection to the developers but only received a generic response. Fun game, but the pay-to-win mechanics ruin it.

Game ads were misleading. It is also a predatory game that you cannot get far without spending a decent amount of money and there will always be people spending insane amounts of money over you. Devs cater to big spenders and their customer service is intensely lacking. Do not recommend this game unless you are just looking to spend to feel powerful.

As usual, its nothing like the ads. It's very annoying that google just let's these hanes get away with false advertising like this. These disgusting business practices need to stop. The ads are a lie. They make it look like some version of The Forest, but it's not even close. You get a preset team to a preset area and restore an entire town while leveling up heroes and fighting mutant zombies. You don't get any real choices or creativity. There is a lot to do though and it's a fairly time occupying game. They just should've been honest about it.

Not like the ads, don't get to pick where your shelter is, no 3rd person hunting or shooting. downloaded following a YouTube ad, and the game, even the images used in play store, are 100% false advertising. this is yet another game using a cookie cutter methodology of rapid advancement at beginning to get you hooked on, before progression grinds to a halt in order to encourage spending. don't fall into the trap of the cute ad. the game has nothing to do with the ad. This is the regular war based zombie world. There are no ads but you will play against large whales (big spenders). nothing like the ad or photos.
