Turns out the pictures in the ad and in the app store are totally different from the game itself. I was hoping for a building game, but it is an adventure game. Also there are only buying (pay to win) options for some of the events and main characters that can help you in the game. I didn't spend a dime, I was hoping for it to get better, but it didn't.

False advertising. I have seen SO MANY ADS for this game, and each one is either a story like game, or a bunker style where you pick a room and upgrade your turrets. I get into the game, and it's a base builder. I don't have time for base building. I DO have time for short games of surviving in a bunker room. So I was really hoping for that, but instead I got a forced tutorial. I'm not even going to give it the time of day anymore. Uninstalling.

False advertising. Game is not like the ad that caused me to download it (showing a cozy game where you build and customize rooms in a tree house), nor is it like any of the screenshots shown on the app page (making it look like a tower defense game similar to Haunted Dorm). Could be a good game, but I'm sick of false advertising, so uninstalling.

It's playable. Way too many of these games once you are past a protected level/time, unless you pay, you're attacked so much by whales, that as a minnow you don't stand a chance. This isn't as bad. Yes, you can lose all of some resources, but you can make it back easily enough. Move, join a better alliance, whatever. But it is pay to win. OMG the number of internal ads is ridiculous. Don't pop up ads over the game! Sure have a store, make the button flash, but don't go nuts. It's like Temu!

I downloaded this game just like everyone else. You might have seen an ad or something like that showing this game off, I thought it looked okay and wanted to at least try it. when I downloaded it and started, it was bringing me through the tutorial. Literally, the first or second mission where you have to "build a kitchen for your base" doesn't work and it keeps freezing the whole game to the point of not being able to play at all. It's not worth downloading if the tutorial doesn't even work.

Stop wasting your time on this game. It's a game where almost everything is just a paywall. It's unoriginal and nothing like the ad videos. I am very disappointed, that I downloaded this game and wasted my time on everything. I can feel the dopamine when I click, upgrade, claim rewards, that's how games get you hooked cuz there's button you can click. I am surprised that there's a lot of voice acting. But the characters are just Ai generated images. To be just good at the game, you need MONEY.

The screenshots and ads about aircraft carrier have nothing to do with the game. After playing for 3 days, the game itself is not bad, voices and language are quite alright, but there are basic logic faults - in spite of a hundred soldiers army and full complement of heroes, zombies break the fence every night, killing people at leasure. Once, they retaliated with shotguns and torches, but that seems to be a random, very seldom mechanic, I haven't found any instructions on starting it.

I was very, very excited to play a game as advertised in the ads. Being inside a van, driving and traveling, pixilated decor, zombie filled roads. Ambiance and life. This is not that game. The misleading advertising alone puts me off. Yet I still tried it, hoping there was something like that. There was nothing. This game is falsely advertised, a pay to win, online competitive with completely different graphics and play style than shown in ads.
just another game that shows one thing but is not the game you play. The same lame answer what a joke. I uninstalled the game.

Extreme Pay to Win. I counted at least $5000 in offers on the first day. Sure, you can ignore the triple full screen pack ads, ads in every event, and ads for all progress. But you won't advance and eventually become fodder. The game is well made and engaging, so I feel compelled to give at least 2 stars. If you don't believe this review, look at the packs within 2 hours of playing.

The graphics are nice (not what is in preview). The story in the beginning was good, too... until you get to a certain point, & if you're not with an alliance, the game is brutal. There's no way I could find to be just a casual player. Your "base" is open for attacks if not shielded 24/7, & when you're attacked, you can either spend days or real money to heal your troops. after getting attacked multiple days, I uninstalled. I just wanted to have a casual game to play when I have some free time.

I changed my star rating to a 1 star. It was fun at first, but then they keep doing updates which not only rearranged everything in-game town, also keeps knocking down my power level by 2 million each time. While this is only a game, the progress is something I want to keep. All of my power level, my equipment, my heroes. It would be awesome if they stopped taking them away. The only good thing about this game is talking to people and making friends.

Misleading ad, boring gameplay loop and very P2W. I'm burnt out on this kind of survival game. This may seem like a well-built game at first, but it's so similar to a multitude of games I've played in this genre, right down to the last mechanic. Tbh it feels less like a game and more like a collection of buttons to release dopamine in your brain. Build this, upgrade that. The game basically plays itself. Credit where it's due tho, the voice acting and story bits do add some character.

If you came here from one of those ads that show up in your social media or game, you'll be disappointed. The graphics, the gameplay, the actual game, is nowhere near what those ads show. I played this for a couple of months but ended up deleting it. It's the usual grind for resources, upgrade buildings, train troops, and try not to get hammered by pay to win players (good luck with that). Last update was so big, I thought they were installing a new game, so I decided to just delete it.

It was really fun at first but it got boring real fast. Based on the ads, I also expected a different game play. And if you wanna level up significantly, you'll have to spend money. The game is fine overall but the ads are misleading. False advertisement. Whatever ads you saw of this game, it's completely different. None of the ads I saw show what this game really is.

Nothing like the ads,the art style is completely different from what's advertised and so is the game, just another generic, pay to win, city building potato. Even the images here are false! Not worth the time,dunno maybe the devs just can't build what they advertise and just want clicks and downloads or maybe the heads of the studio just do whatever they want even if the devs can build it, whatever the case they failed to deliver. Save yourself some time and memory space and don't download this!

They change what ever in game anyway they liked it, in the last patch update, they get rid an expensive item with just slightly above average item, just because the expensive items is now gatcha stuff and you must buy it with $$$$, instead giving player what they should have, they just giving them some free cheap stuff, totally ignoring player progress for it... So if you didn't want to get scam by dev, stop playing it.

Fun graphics, decent gameplay. Game does a really good job of letting one get far before you have to start paying just to stay afloat. This game is essentially the same as a dozen other resource grinders on the play store, just with a zombie graphic pack. I appreciate that everyone needs to make money, but would be more fun if it was optional to spend, rather than hindering the game's advancement unless one spends.

I love it game. There are so many free items daily. I like how you can delete notifications with quick.delete.icon. I enjoy the game play with no lag and really kawaii characters. 🤨 But I don't like the amount of time it takes to train soilders and training = only a few.. I wish it reduce time a bit. 🤩I really enjoyed in the beginning when they had the trail where you fight m9nsters and collect stuff. It was so cute. But it was cut short. 🥰 Do recommend this game! Really fun & addictive.

The initial gameplay experience was great, making me think it was just a zombie-fighting and base-building game. However, it soon took a turn for the worse. The game requires players to fight against other players, and it adopts a "bullying the weak" model. If you start playing even just one day later than others, you’ll always be weaker.What’s even more absurd is that the system allows a single player to repeatedly attack your base until you’re left with no resources at all.

Its unfortunately not like the ads with the underground bases (fallout shelter style, but prettier). That said, for a Whiteout game it's pretty fun. I usually get bored of these types of games quickly but there's enough different things to do and expand so for now I'm having fun. Just be warned that you can only build one thing at a time unless you buy an extra queue, so there will be long waits unless you pay cash.

This game is shady. Not only is it not as advertised but there is a lot of rumors and people have problems with their accounts being charged twice when making purchases. It is pay to "win" if you can get past all of the glitches and "bugs". It can be a good time waster though. There is plenty to do, a lot to accomplish/collect & many events as well. But overall I've heard to much and have seen to many people have problems with this game to trust it. I will be uninstalling.

False Advertising. Apparently they run different ads which show gameplay of different types of games... none of which are actually in Dark War Survival. If you've seen the one where you go to sleep in a room and upgrade the door from monsters that try to bust in? Download "Haunted Dorm". That app is quite literally that game. The graphics are different, but that's the exact game they based those ads on. So if you really wanted to experience it, try that.

Played for 10 mins and realized it's not at all what it was advertised as. That's honestly to be expected now, but the really frustrating part is it doesn't even look like the pictures posted on the play store, which made it look something like fallout shelter with the underground bunker. Just completely false advertising using AI images in the ads and on the play store. It's just another pay to play game that you build and upgrade stuff, like so many others. Boring and repetitive. No thanks.

The marketing for this game is completely false advertising and AI generated. I played the game anyway to see how close the game is to the images. It's not close. Honestly, I don't mind the cartoony style of the actual game. There's no need to lie about its appearance, it looks fine. The AI that they used to voice the NPCs is also not that bad. The game is a generic, braindead city-builder, but can be a fun time waster. Overall, the game is mid, but it lies in its ads, so its a 1 star review max

This game is engaging at first; nice story, cool setting. and easy going. After you level up a bit the game changes completely and has nothing to do with zombies anymore. You farm good and resources for days, but when a higher level player attacks you, you lose everything in less than 1 minute, and there's nothing you can do about it. Various ingame ads prevent you to shield up quickly. You have to level up to protect you resources, but you can't level up because your recourses are always gone.

Ads for this game show a tower based game, going underground, with a stylized thick line art and looks lovely. The actual game is not like this, has a tower, but it's a light house and it has many purchase points to spend irl cash. No ads so far, so that's why it's 2 stars not 1 star. Faulty advertising should be punished. Its a mixture of frostpunk/wintersurvival and many of the other army building games out there.

Will be uninstalling. I thought from the pictures, this game would be totally about skill and possibly time management to survive a zombie apocalypse, but no, it's the same boring repetitive zombie world/camp building game and if you think finding Rex was too easy, it was, because you can't progress his story unless you pay. So, truly is a pay to play for good heros and what not. Thought there would be choices you had to make too, but nope.

The new ads for this game showing the almost first person type play, is a complete lie! I played this game for many months, grinding and grinding. It takes months to even become competetive against others. Joining an alliance is not mandatory, but it might as well be if you don't want to lose all of your long awaited loot and make any progress. At a certain point it literally takes real time weeks to upgrade even the smallest things. Which in turn makes it pay to play in order to keep up. 👎🏼👎

I really enjoyed playing this game in a different year. I'm really upset that the game is an ad and clickbait. I don't think it seems right. If the production itself was spent solely on the idea of that ad...8bit with seasons... I guarantee wholeheartedly your fans and I would purchase a game like that every month. It challenges the mind. We become ravelled with the puzzle. until then, you get one star for clickbait

Got an ad for this game that showed mini living areas in the trees, with beautiful ghibli style characters and nice music with rain. I knew it'd be misleading when the game icon didn't match that style, and other reviews confirm this as well. Maybe you'd get less bad reviews if you stopped being misleading. You keep responding that it's to "show an apocalyptic theme" or whatever, but you can do that with actual gameplay that won't mislead people. If you have to resort to that, your game is bad.

Installed this game because it's marketed as a cozy survival almost lofi looking game. The ads show a lovely adventure with ambiance and a cute bus, but it is in no way shape or form cozy or anything even close to it. Advertisements are 100% untrue. And to add to the disappointment, the game starts out super easy, and then it gets very difficult and hard to progress without paying real money. If I could, I would give 0 stars..I don't think I've ever been so disappointed by an ad vs the real game

It comes together well enough at the start that you might not notice it up front, but so much of this game is low-quality, AI-generated garbage. And no, I don't just mean the ads (tho they are AI-generated too), but I'm saying that the art, story, and voice acting in-game are also all AI. And the quality of all these parts goes down the further you get into the game. Clearly they were focused more on that first hour so they can squeeze some money out of you, and then they stopped caring.

Better than others of its kind, but has the same main problem like others: whales will bully you and your alliance all the way! If the Devs could/would limit that one can only attack others of the same strength (within a range of 4-5 levels) this game would be outstanding. At the time of my review, it's ok, but I won't play a day longer than the first month I paid for.

The game is really great but that is how as far as it goes. It starts off interestingly and got mini games to entertain yourself and actually engage yourself in the game. However, you cannot get a decent strong team if you're not gonna pay for it. It's definitely a pay2win game. I cannot progress a bit more after reaching about 879k strength because you'd have to pay for strong characters. Aside from that, they also use mostly AI in the game. It has potential, though. Hope you can make it f2p.

False advertising!! The ad was completely different than the game. The ad has rain falling peacefully and a lit up cozy tree like home that you would build. It implied the game would be relaxing. The first scene is running from zombies. The rest is nothing like the ad. I hate this. Just tell me what your game is like. Stop telling me lies just to sell it. Maybe you should make the other game actually like the lies you told to sell it please.

Once again false advertising to get you to download. The add I say was a game play were you had to hide and add weapons to kill the zombies. What the game actually is is just story telling and clicking. There is no game play at all. You can't even control the characters. I truly hate that this has become the norm with apps. If your game is good than advertise the real game. Don't advertise false game play to get people to download the game and play to see if it will ever be like the ad.

Revising my review once again. I thought the game was just a rampant cash grab. Although it is still very pay to win, the developers has put a lot of thought into the evolution of events. the game is also quite polished for most parts. As a player, you are still at the mercy of whales and there's really very little to do as a solo player. The game is very social centric, and finding a team of players you enjoy chatting with will make or break your experience.

Love how if you roast them, you don't get to leave a review. Anyway, very much a pay and you'll be able to do everything in the game. Not bad but not necessarily different from the rest of the games like it. Similar to any other survival type mobile game where the whalers get to have their run of the server and do what they can to prevent newer and more casual players from progressing with raiding and destroying of bases. Overall its fine, few really nice game related things like the story.

Every time you log in, you are plagued with multiple pop-ups to buy something new in order to help advance and progress. every screen and requires an action is spread out unnecessarily just to be presented with more in-app purchases. Pay to win... This game is no different than any other game. This is a pay to win ype of game. It's boring. clean up your menus, make it less of a hassle to collect any minor rewards we've earned by grinding through the repetitiveness.

This game, though similar in concept to a zombie-themed setting, lacks originality. It's almost a carbon copy of "Whiteout Survival." If you've played either game, you'll notice the "Tasks" section is positioned in the exact same spot. The introduction mirrors Whiteout Survival as well—only instead of escaping from the cold, you're escaping from zombies. Even the game code appears identical when comparing both side by side.

If the supplied images show only art work, rather than actual game play or screens, it's always an automatic NO download for me. Show us what the game actually looks like, rather than just some "cool drawings". A lot of us would rather know what the actual gameplay looks like. The artwork is nice, but damn! ALL of them? Come on! Do better. Show us!

The storyline, graphics, and sounds have so much detail, and I had high hopes at first. But for casual play, this was really disappointing as the alliances all want you to join discord and kick you if you don't comply. It made me really frustrated, as playing without an alliance doesn't let you experience all of the game. Would not recommend if you only can pick it up once a day for a short time.

Same ole game of upgrade your buildings and have your heros do attacks along a path. Upgrade your fire in the middle to level up. Level up your heros, etc. The graphics displayed as their promo is nothing like the game. The temptation of being able to build your base in a tree or on the side of a cliff, etc, and having creative control does not exist. It gets boring pretty quick. Uninstalling.

I normally don't write reviews, but this game has been too much. It's the biggest pay-to-win I've encountered so far. The events are almost identical, completely recycled from each other, and they constantly release paid packs so you can 'progress.' I know that's common in mobile games, but in this one, it's completely abusive. Moreover, the advertising and images don't match the actual gameplay. I don't recommend it—it's absolutely not F2P-friendly

Fun game overall, however there is little to no information about the game online therefore most of what you learn is from others in-game as well as trial and error. Not even an x account to keep players updated with latest game related news. As of this time, I have not been able to log in due to a "connection error" for over 10 hours. There was no mention of maintenance, so I have no way of knowing if that is the cause or if the issue is on my end.

it is FAR from anything like the advertisements. It has the pictures sure, but it's just like any other game, like Whiteout Survival, just have the tower and build around it that's it. If you were looking forward to the advertisement kind of game, you'll be sorely disappointed. I put it down for two stars, cause I got stuck in charge of an Alliance by chance, and I've been sticking to it for the members' sake. They are pretty diligent.

The game was fun for 3-5 days, then the game became a chore. Too much grinding, mini games are stale and repetitive. The worst thing was the consistent set of ads every time you open the game. It was obnoxious to close the same ads over and over again. Overall not worth playing as you only "add" more work to your laundry list daily to proceed. I do not recommend this game...

naa. I played it for the ad preview and it looked relaxing and fun. but it's just one of these games where you build constantly, you get attacked by others, you in a guild, lots of small or big monster fights in map mode, lots of things to tell you to buy this and that, you build different building, you train troops, make a hospital, make houses, other building which I thought are useless, you go out and collect materials for hours, your guild peoples help you faster construction, gotta research

Ads were pretty much false advertising... Building defenses to hold off a giant monster while sleeping in a room is a tiny part of the game. This isn't a defense game, but more a "Clash of Clans" kind of game. Paywall for most good things, need a good clan to actually progress after a point. Doesn't give enough heroes or resources to make this game fun. Leveling characters is beyond grindy. Villager "upgrades" come with heavy caveats, so horrible upgrades, too. Regret downloading. >_>;

It started out different and interesting with unique aspects. But after they suck you in and take your money they changed it into a hollow copy of every other similar game, and not even the best parts of them. Don't waste your time, play State of Survival or any of the originals instead, at least those ones are better thought out. I'm extremely disappointed. Started playing this with such high hopes. It is definitely a p2p don't be fooled.

It's a nice game has a lot of potential for the right crowd, but I'm giving it one star because it doesn't sell itself as ANYTHING in accordance with what it is. The preview pictures look nothing like the game. I clicked on it because it showed Terraria style gameplay in the ad on Instagram, and it's also not like that. Give honest marketing and maybe you'll find the right audience. Putting up fake pictures does not help you, it just makes you look bad.

False advertising, the game is nothing like the ad. It's yet another one of those games where you can't win unless you pay cash and even then, your hard work (and money) get obliterated by other players if you dare leave the game for 5 minutes. Disappointed. I really thought the devs came up with something new and exciting but unfortunately, it's just a copy-and-paste of every other Clash of Clans type game out there. Uninstalled.

Ok but misleading store page. The store images look nothing like the in game play. I was excited for what looked like a unique style, but it's fairly generic. That said, it's high quality art just not as unique. Gameplay is same as many others but mixes in a few mechanics together and does most of them well. It's a solid game just disappointed it's not like the pictures

Not too bad of a game. Def not a zombie survival game based on ads. More of building base and defending from other players. They do have events related to zombies but the primary objective is PvP. Giving a chance but will move on to another game of a different genre. Update 1: Support is not responsive. Purchased packs and didn't receive items twice. Glitchy game. Update 2: was finally able to get ahold of support through their Discord Channel, which was hard to find. They do not offer refunds.

Saw an ad on Facebook. I looked into it, and it kind of looked like some kinda fallout shelter game and looked cool. thought to check it out, and the game is completely different. Fine, I'll uninstall it. comes to the page, and the game photos are different from what I saw before and still aint in game photos. Might be a fun game, but dont mislead people.

The advertising that brought me to this game is a flat out lie, you cannot customize your shelter in the way the ads show, stop lying and show the real game in the ads. The game is actually fun and I like the art style. It's pretty simple to pick and play so far. I like the fact there is an ok story and the voice acting is passable. I do not like a lot of the lines these characters say, they are very, VERY, stupid. As if someone who does not speak English wrote them. Please get better dialogue.

It feels like a cash grab and has many low quality or AI generated characters meaning that this game wasn't given actual dedication to some parts of it. The only thing that I find great is how easy it is to obtain gems. Many of the high level players in the game have shown/admitted that they put a bunch of money into the game just to make themselves more op against other players.

Used to be a nice game until the devs got money grabby and nerfed everything. No more gear crafting, only random drops. The orange gear costs $50 for each piece, so if you want to trick out a hero that's $200. Took away 1 min rallies and now only 5+ min. Changed my rating from 5 to 1, all solely the mistakes made by the devs. too bad, because it was a fairly snappy game at first.

This is a pay to win game. The more money you spend the higher your chance of not becoming a farm for others. They offer 200 rubies for a 5 star review. The games rewards do not get you anything. You have to spend money to progress. every challenge requires you to purchase a package to complete the challenge. Expect to spend money daily or quit. Its cheaper to buy a PS5 and actually have fun.

Dark War Survival is very disappointing. The game keeps updating almost every time you open it, which is annoying and wastes a lot of time. Also, it's too pay-to-win. You need to spend a lot of money just to increase your power and get good items. It feels like a scam because the game is clearly pushing players to spend money in order to enjoy or progress. It's no longer fun—just frustrating.

not quite what they advertised. I was hoping I would be building the tower I kept seeing in the ad, but of course, the actual game was nothing like the ad. Honestly, there's no reason the ad couldn't show more actual game footage. It's a standard base building/ online team strategy game with decent graphics and a nice player base looking to help. If you had caught me when I was playing these games, I would have been quite happy with this game.

There's one word to describe this whole game, scam. The game doesn't look any close to what advertised on the page. All the pictures in the advert are all AI generated. It's advertised as a dark survival apocalypse type of game, which turns out to be a lame and lazy camp building game. The graphics doesn't even look appealing, it's just a cheap cartoon looks. And for this game to have above 4.5 stars, it's possible that the developers bought those review bots to make this game has high ratings.

Incredibly misleading advertising. I was initially interested because it was advertised as a cute pixel game. Once I downloaded it, it turned out to be an asset flip using textures and characters from other games like "Last War:Survival Game" and "Last Z:Survival Shooter. Do not download. It's a lazy product designed to get you to buy in-game credit.

STOP - This is not worth your time and money. At the beginning it seems promising, with nice animations and storyline... but all suddenly disappear once you've stepped into the main part of the game. You no longer fights zombie, but human (lol?). The rest of the game UI is like a high school project. The world map is like a game from 90s... Not to mention it is purely a PAY TO WIN game. Everything will cost money and there is no other way around. If you play free you are always the punching bag.

If you don't buy the add ons, as soon as the map opens up, you get completely destroyed. Save your time... Honestly, I was even an alliance leader, and it's just a mess. I passed off all I could to the few people who actually played, deleted my profile, and won't ever be downloading this waste of time again. Granted I did like some aspects of the game, but nothing like what was 'sold to me.' Very misleading.

I've been playing for months and suddenly my in game translator stopped working. A friend told me to check if I had an update and I did. Initially, it wouldn't even update just had me clicking the update button over and over. Then, when it finally updated, now I can't get into the game. Gets to 18% loaded then tells me there's a connection error. I'm on the same wifi ive always been on playing this game so what the hell is the deal??

The artwork is neat. The theme is great. The gameplay is garbage. As with any game like this, it forces pvp and is play to win. No strategy or actual gaming. You'll win based on how deep your pockets are. It's easy at first and requires very little, but once you're jnvested, it will require money. I expected this and didn't pay anything. Play for free for a while, but don't invest any money.

The game is good. Customer support is terrible. It is pay to win, but reasonable. You can play for free, but hard to really compete without buying items. I spent some money to get a specific item. The item was dropped in my inventory, but when I clicked it, the item disappeared. I contacted the devs through the in-game chat, which is the only method to do so. Zero response for 5 days now. Very disappointing. Enough to make me want to quit after spending a decent chunk of change.

Looks nothing like the ads. its a base builder where you have to work with an alliance to secure territories to progress into the top alliances of the game and control the Capitol. I like that you don't NEED to put money into. But it's an option if you got it like that. Theres a discord that teaches you A LOT about the game and that's awesome. Each server has its own rules btw. And you can make 2 bases at once when you get the hang of things. Also the lead in and tutorial parts are a bit long.

Just more slop. I've tried 3 other games with the same cookie cutter design. Literally just a reskin but instead of gas or the cold it's zombies. Voicelines and character portraits are ai and it just becomes a grindfest after 30 minutes. 10 minutes into it and you get shown a buy screen for a hero "reg: 97.99 but on sale 1.33" sort of act now to milk the whales like the other games do. Don't waste your time

So was fun, as stated in other reviews the ads for it are not the actual game. It forces you into alliances and you have to hit certain check points in order to unlock chatting etc. I was enjoying the game.... until it basically makes you pay real money to go forward. Which sucks cause I would have kept playing the game. Deleted as soon as I realized I needed to pay real money to continue

it just sucks. the art is "alright" and that's about it. 95% of the gameplay is NOT what the obnoxious ads are, in fact, some of that content I haven't seen at all. It's basic click click click play without thinking about what is going on. the day timer is not counting in actual minutes and feels broken honestly, which is WORSE when you realize there are timed builds. it's not worth the several hours over a couple days I've tried playing it.

I was really enjoying the game. That is until I needed some tech support. Nothing. You could hear crickets singing. I also emailed. Once again, nothing. It would appear the developers are very happy to take exorbitant amounts off players who ptw. This game is a cash cow for the developers. Edit: I've since heard from other players, that only those who spend huge amount of money get assistance. My suspicions were correct. new updates are designed for the money spenders. Think twice b4 download

This is not the game advertised or in the screenshots. I played this game to chapter three and still nothing. It's not an sandbox survival game. It's a base upgrade game where you basically tap different parts of the base over and over such as Kitchen and Scrapyard only to then tap your way through terrible dialogue. And repeat the process. I did it to Chapter 3 and realized it wasn't going to be the game I thought it was. Don't waste your time.

the marketing for this game is 100% not accurate. I tried this out because it said it was a cozy survival game. this is anything but cozy. this game is just like every other app store game out there and that it tries to get you hooked early by making things easy and then as you progress it gets much more difficult and they pop up advertisements all the time trying to get you to buy coins and discounts and memberships and everything else.

Game is nothing like advertised. I tried to delete my account, and it kept saying it couldn't delete it because it is connected to an email address. I didn't provide any email address. When I contacted customer service, they just gave me the run around repeating the steps that I already went through. And they just ended the chat, essentially hanging up on me, so I had to start over with my complaint. Terrible customer service.

Cool pixel art ad has nothing to do with the game. The preview screenshots here in the app page keep changing and also have nothing to do with the game. The developer clearly has no confidence in their actual product's appearance, so are instead just tricking people into downloading it. The actual game (not seen in the ads or previews) is just a boring base building game. I have no idea if I really got around to playing much of anything. First 30 minutes is just mind numbing tutorials.

False advertisement. I kept seeing ads for this which were beautiful scenic vertical bases underground or on cliff faces or something. It starts as this story and I quickly realize, Ugh, base building following the story. Not even, it then turns into a game that you beat with specific fighting characters that you collect or buy. Its automatic fighting too, not like there's skill. Then, nope, its one of those games with other players you join and there's a big map. Just complete false all way.

*We love to see a team that listens to the heart of the game - it's players! Thank you DWS! ------ I have loved and played this game for over a year now, but it's sad to see they've become just as greedy as every other game now. Make choices that want your players to play and thrive, not run them off!

The game is ok, very popular gameplay nowadays. Dialogs takes too long to finish, tho, and you can only skip occasionally. The ads of this game sells something completely different from reality, very deceiving. "Your choice matter" but you don't actually have choices in-game. But I'm leaving the game because of the community. Jesus Christ. People demanding wpp or discord messages. Creating groups to keep in touch outside the game. Feels like a real life work on deadline. Very stressful.

Advertisement has nothing to do with real gameplay, same as "screenshots" in google play. It is just another survival base-building strategy which takes a lot of real time to develop, build base, army etc. There is nothing as they say "innovative". "Best game of 2025" title is also just and advertisement. There are plenty of similar games available since many years ago. I hope one day there will be a regulation to show real gameplay in advertisement, not some nice picture to draw an attention.

The game is good but unfortunately the images shown in the Play store versus the actual game is very very different. It does not look like a side scroller type of game, it's a top-down view survival base building game archetype where you invade other players on the map, combined with idle loot farming mechanics. If the devs showed the actual game images rather than images that can't be found anywhere in the game, they'd still have a good player base.

Started out a lot of fun, but has turned into pay to play! Everytime you begin to make progress the devs "update" the game which actually set you back further. Good luck on getting in touch with the devs, as there is no clear cut way to even bring your concerns. Not to mention the bullies in the game with no way to report them and stop the bullying/harassment. I just want my money back so that I can move on!!!!!

I tried out this game because I was looking for a good survival game, and the images being shown made it look interesting. But as soon as I open the game, it shows that it's nothing like what their putting out there. It gets boring fast, and the whole design feels like they barely put any effort into it. the whole thing is AI, I feel like they just throw Ai together and called it a day. It’s freaking disappointing. The creators relied too much on AI art, making the game feel uninspired n poorly.

The ads are misleading. Even the pics on Google Play are very different from actual gameplay. They excessively use AI almost at every part of the game and ads. Inconsistent artstyle, weird voice over, over-sexualized women character, nonexistent tower build/underground shelter type of gameplay (ad). Honestly the game wouldn't be that bad if u could just be honest about the ad/gameplay. Especially if you're looking for a long term player, but who knows maybe the intention was just for clickbaits.

so sick of these devs.. just make an ad that shows your ACTUAL gameplay. the only fighting that occurred was passive.. it might be a fun game for some, but im not into that style of gaming. if i had known the style i never would have downloaded it, and that's why your getting 1 star. ..false advertisement. ** REPLY TO DEVELOPER.. What you meant to say is "We apologize for not accurately representing our game in the ad. we didnt realize that would be a problem but will correct it asap."

Not like the ad at all! Clickbait! You are just upgrading buildings constantly, without any actual game play. Total take off of Whiteout. There are the mini game battles, but you basically just sit there and watch them fight. This is exactly why I don't play Whiteout anymore. Why do they always show a seemingly fun game, then give you a boring one? Uninstalling. Don't waste your time!

It's just another generic base building cash grab game, this time with a zombie theme. You get blasted with ads for in-game purchases each time you open the game. Also, you are able to level up your heroes at breakneck speeds up until a certain point. The game becomes way too grindy. Upgrades cost way too much for the benefit. Uninstalling

Very much an eXterminate game!! This is a heavy PvP / PK game. It starts off as somewhat world building, collecting, leveling. Very soon the initial 'protection' wears off and new players get attacked by higher level players - again and again, mostly while they're offline. As the 'seasons' progress (they don't tell you about the seasons) it gets more and more away from surviving zombie apocalypse and becomes pretty much, destroy the other players and take their stuff.

P2W Game. If you don't pay to speed up upgrades and army building, you won't have chance of survival for long. The High paying people form an alliance (clan) and become most powerful and they keep attacking whoever they want. Lot of events in the game and each event is curated in a way that you will be compelled to pay. This game is no different that any other similar genre game. It has the same mechanics. In fact this game, apart from graphics is the exact replica of Whiteout Survival game.

if the game were advertised as it actually plays, I would rate this more highly, but it is nothing like the ads. the graphics, and play are nothing like the ads; it's a classic bait and switch. if it were advertised as it plays, it's not a bad game, but that's not what I was looking for & franky the false advertising pissed me off, so I deleted it after playing for a few days.

The game is a pay to play type game. While I knew this going in, what I didn't know is how piss poor the rewards are that you pay for. You get little to nothing, unless you pay exorbitant amounts. most packages only give you very few items. the game also constantly has you alliance dueling battling, needing to spend in order to keep up. many rewards unavailable unless you pay for them. way better pay to play games out there, ones that actually give you your moneys worth. this ain't it.

Game starts out with good experience but then turns into a money pit where if you don't spend hundreds of thousands of $$$, you will get camped and farmed. Everything is overpriced, and I can't see people spending that kinda money, which means there are probably in-game bots/ people given free stuff, so they are able to harrias you into buying more to be competitive. I wanted to give this game the benefit of the doubt, but nope, it's a cash grab.

Bad experience. Ive been playing this for a couple of days already. But I uninstalled it when it seems the game is running at less than 100% speed for some reason. When I installed it again today, the whole game was reset from the beginning! Ive wasted time and spent some money on the first run. Now its gone. Do not play this, its waste of time and money.

Meh, it's very basic, there isn't much to the game besides upgrading your things and fighting some monsters and rivals. But there's nothing you can do while they fight, no boosts or something to tip the winning scale. if you're weaker then the competitor, you are going to lose 99% of the time. and even if u do win its only against those that are a teeny, tinny but stronger then you. the only thing that kept me playing was the nightmare mini game in it, maybe turn that into a full game.

What I find disappointing is that the promotion movie shows an Anime style atmosphere, but the game design is more cartoon like. So I expected a more character oriented game, but this is more of a territory battle. Gameplay is quite repetitive and demands a lot of time to achieve progress. So not so stimulating while playing. It still is fun to play in the beginning. But not so engaging or captivating.

Another game that looks nothing like what's advertised. It's an idle zombie survival game with cartoonish graphics. Some people are probably into that, but the game was advertised as having a technical, anime style graphically and be about a solo player building a cool shelter, like treehouse, mobile home, or a bunker. The gameplay is more of an npc group of people who build for a specified period of time as defined by the player. I liked the ads. I didn't like the idle gameplay or graphics.

While this game has little or nothing to do with its ads, I did continue to play for a couple of weeks. If you enjoy war based strategy games that rely heavily on guild involvement, then you'll enjoy this game. You must play to win if you want to do well. I enjoyed building into my zombie base but it doesn't take long to cap out on that and all that's left is war with other clans and players. 3 stars because it is a good game for what it is, minus 2 for ad manipulation.

I loved the game at the begging, but started finding it difficult once I needed a clan. For all of the clans you are required to play at least an hour per day, a thing that not everyone can do. This gave me social anxiety. I don't recommend this game if you work, study and/or don't have a way to pay for the premium packages. I don't recommend it if you have social anxiety either, clans can become bullying environments.

It's not the slice of life like the ads portray, but it's still a fun game. As to be expect there are a lot of timers, at first it's not too bad, but later on some of these timers get pretty lengthy (days at a time) The cash shop is my biggest gripe. I just wish things weren't so expensive. $15 for monthly pass, ok fine no problem, but when it comes to $30+ for a character or weapon or upgrades I have a hard time justifying it. The FTP area is not bad get yourself into a group things ill be ok

Okay, game... Misleading advertisement... It's not my type of game... I was expecting hand drawn oxygennotincluded/don't starve/borderlands style art. The story is rich, there is much dialouge, some world building, but it's the same gameplay and visuals as whiteout survival... really sad marketing, to be honest. The cozy bunkes were too good to be true, and i fell for it.

The game was pretty well made. I just don't like the constant spamming of purchasing things. Some of the higher players seem like they spend over tens of thousands on this game. How are you supposed to compete with that when you are barely starting out. The game makes me think of whiteout survival even if that game was disgusting with all the marketing purchases you got spammed by, and it was a complete joke, honestly. All in all, the game wasn't all that terrible.

Does anybody else see the redundancy of these games? Build some city, wait for upgrades, or pay for them if you can't wait. This one has zombies, this one has flowers. Oh, look! This one has the mafia. Whztever! It's the same game, and there are hundreds. When you see an ad with a game that looks interesting. It's not that game you download? There might be some side game l8ke that but it costs money. What a sham.

cannot play. attempted to log onto game, but it tells me there is no network connection. I'm connected to WiFi, so I'm not sure what the problem is. I attempted to troubleshoot the issue. Figured I can play on data but the game will not work on WiFi. The short time I did manage to play, met a lot of jerk players. I joined an alliance and was booted within an hour for "inactivity"

Meh. The ads shows very detailed buildings and the interiors, made me think you could chose where you would like to begin or why not start at the beginning of the apocalypse from your house and you have to find a new safe place. Instead, you get a whiteout survival level details, no choice in location, and literally not a choice on getting equipment to survive. Why not the style advertised? Why not a gameplay with multiple choices so players can find out if their gameplan can actually save them?

It's fun, but paying to win is notable. There isn't any long-term value in it otherwise because other players will just steamroll you. Also, some heroes are held hostage by pay walls. Think ransom money for their lives type deal. Another note, at this point in time it is falsely advertising itself as something it's not. Shameful that. EDIT 30 to 40 dollars to get something. What heck. This game is for whales only at the 15 - 100 level. No way can you play this otherwise. They will eat you alive.

Horrible experience. Overall game concept is good, but once you get a bit deeper into the game you just become fodder for stronger sanctuaries as they will attack you constantly. Each day I started I would've been attacked 10-20 times by the same person and will lose over a million RSS. Every damn day this happens. Also, gameplay is not as advertised and pay to win is way over priced. And you do need to pay to survive, though you're really just paying for a stronger person's success.

Some of the ads for this game are wholly misleading. One ad suggests that this is some kind of cozy game, claiming "most relaxing game" and showing pics of shelters. First of all, this isn't a cozy game. And it's not a game like Farmville, lol. It's a survival war game basically. The majority of your time is spent building your shelter, building and strengthening your troops, joining an alliance, attacking other players and alliances, etc. Game is fine for what it is. The ads are misleading.

I feel like after a certain level, the game goes a little astray of its debut concept.... Secondly, and also at a certain level you'll be required to purchase some items which are not bad but there are no equivalent chances for people who don't have the means to buy those said items. And finally there is only one way to recover your account if it's mistakenly deleted and that is to bind it to an email, which is really frustrating and regrettable in case a person forgot to bind it....

This game is a classic example of pay-to-win mechanics, using FOMO and gacha tactics to force you into spending. The monetization is incredibly aggressive, and it's clear that progression without spending a lot is nearly impossible. It may seem fun at first, but it quickly becomes a money trap. My advice: avoid it unless you're willing to drop a lot of cash and then move on quickly, as soon as you decide to stop spending, you will sink instantly. You either spend consistently, or be fodder.

Game needs tweaking. Has promise but the first thing that caught my attention is how expensive packs are. With so many games like this, I don't know why they think they can pull in $25 for a Monthly Pass when others charge $5-$10. It's fun until you get to level 9, then it comes to a screeching halt. Now the buildings take HOURS to upgrade already. Past level 99, the Adventures ramp up in difficulty so you can't do them anymore. Probably why so many dead cities at lvl 9-10, they got bored.

I like the game, but wish it wasn't so Alliance reliant. I would like to be able to complete all the quests independently. Roamer defeats should be a substitute for those who are alliance unbound. I want to play how I want, not how a group dictates....especially when I'm spending my own money. It would also be nice to just have a place to go and purchase things when ready, not characters and things to buy popping out at you every second. The advertisements are only annoying, not encouraging.

The game is 0 like the ads. which is BIZARRE. Aside from that, the game is playable. It is obnoxious to play on a mobile phone screen. It feels overly busy for being so far spread out. for me, I just did not like it. too much talking and interrupted moments. The graphics are good, the art style is too cartoonish for me. like, little kid cartoon. The entire game feels off. Not for me.

Fun but Misleading. Fun if you like a survival alliance based game that makes you play with other people. The game had its own charms and is over all Fun. However, incredibly misleading. The ad for this game is nothing like the actual game play. When I installed it I was wanting what the ad described. A Fallot Shelter type feel to it. The art was great and the pull was there. Until I installed it and found out what the game really was. But I said he'll with it and gave it a chance.

False advertisement. Everything from their facebook ads to the game icon to store images are forged by AI and do not reflect the style, characters, or gameplay. In spite of this, the game itself shows a decent production value. But to have my first experience with a new product be deceit is something I can not accept. And they ruined their chance of gaining my trust.

Where in the game can I find any scenes that look like the ones in the previews? Nowhere. This is blatant false advertising! The promotional images suggest a realistic visual style, but the actual game is undeniably cartoonish. It’s misleading and disappointing for players expecting something closer to what was advertised. If you’re looking for the experience shown in the previews, you won’t find it here.

I enjoy the game m, it does get boring, and the new things are the same things, just different colors and names... but the friends you make are extremely enjoying.. I think the sensory needs to be lifted a lot, IMO.. Now, the downside to this game (which if it weren't for the friends I made I'd probably have left game as well). they are making it very hard for people that are f2p to get anywhere, all the side events, exclusive weapons everything must be paid for.. terrible for f2p..

Now, now.. The dev bring post-apocalypse and zombie theme in these game, while the rest, it's.. gather resources, upgrade, on and on.. and you can't proceed if you don't upgrade to specific point because the zombie trails of getting stronger and stronger. The art style, graphics is good, AI Generated, but, to be honest, it's too bad the game need internet connection. It will be great if also support offline play

These guys need to learn how to do updates, they should limit it to once a week max. Instead it's like every 12 hrs and it's really frustrating. Also they are way too hardcore on the pay to play model and you get almost nothing for what you pay for, they should limit it to a weekly and monthly pass and that's it instead of paying for a hundred different things. Really really really bad value if you do choose to pay.

As per usual, I saw this game ad on youtube. It's an ai ads, obviously. Downloaded the game, and wow, what a suprise it's not the same thing shown in the ads. After like an hour or so, i uninstalled the game. It's shows that the devs will try to get you to download the game and entice you to buy any microtransation and then reinvest the money not in the game quality but in the same ai slop ad you keep seeing, and maybe put a bit of that of money on slop content.

Same type of shameless cash grab game you see everywhere in the play store. Overdone trash category of game. The single player portion in the beginning of leaving your base was fun then the types of battles change to just sitting there watching. I already know that will end and you'll be forced to spend too much time or too much money to have any fun or win. Save your time play and just don't install

I downloaded the game after seeing an add, but this game is completely 100% not what was advertised, even the pictures for the app aren't the same. It's just another one of those town building games where you would have to spend a whole lot of money just to get ahead in the game or play for free and be miserable. Uninstalling and will be reporting any future ads I see as false! Seriously do you really think your game is so bad that you have to lie in order to get people to download it!!!!

Bruh...I just got fed a bogus ad on YT that was nothing but plagerized gameplay from an entirely unrelated PC/consol dystopian horror game called "Inside," but some details had been altered. I recognized it right away, because I like "Inside" a lot. The absolute garbage false advertising crapped out by this developer's marketing people is astounding. While we're on the topic, "Inside" is a good game, and I recommend it. What I don't recommend, however, is supporting this fraudulent developer.

It's a pretty standard and boring mobile base builder. If you've played the ones where you have to build a base, castle, or fort, by tapping buttons on the screen until you get to the various online components, you've played this game. It's just zombie skinned. Not very inventive or interesting. A lot of the characters look like meh AI art.

You're going to spend a lot of money on this game. Well over thousands of dollars to stay at the top or compete. This isn't a joke or made up. I'm telling you because I know. The packs for building soldiers are horrible. The wait times for building are extreme. Level 25 takes over 11 days. At level 24 I'm only creating 60+ soldiers @ 12 hours (ridiculous). Good luck.

It's a nice game and also open to free-to-play gamers however I find it too greedy on how pricey the top-ups and also the events are mostly for pay-to-win . You'll notice that the players who stays longer are only those spenders. Non-spenders leave the game because it seems the game doesn't have much more to offer to them after reaching lvl 11 or so. A bit disappointing .

This is a game that isn't worth anyone's time. Just from the ad alone, which wasn't even of the game - one can see that it isn't worth anyone's time. The ad I saw was a little anime style thing, with a girl sitting in a little mobile tiny home or whatever with zombies following it on the road. The advert shows nothing about what the game actually is, which is just another clone of a thousand other survival games.

Total scam. Want to play- pay, want to farm - pay, want to research - pay....and so on. The algorithm of the game is a total classic gambling where casino alsways wins. The animation and the design of the game are boring and repetitive, get tired after few hours. Even if a player has a huge patience, the algorithm figures out in what field are you investing, and increases the waiting time there, inctreases the cost of those materials...etc, the only solution - make you pay....

Horrible Updates and Heavy P2W. Each update seems like it lowers players' battle power on purpose. As if they want players swiping their wallets even more. This is NOT friendly towards free to play players. If you do not become a spender, you will quickly become fodder. You will have a difficult time progressing as big spending alliances run you over. Yes, this game is HEAVYILY PAY-TO-WIN! Disgusting "buy pack" ads on everything you do. You either become a whale or an insect here.

sorry but no. the ad looked so great. I love pixel art like games. the cheaply AI generated images in the app store already raised my doubts. then I downloaded it, the loading screen and first cut scene are 3d. I get it's located Within this game, but don't go advertising it like it's an entirely pixel art game about chilling in a zombie apocalypse surviving... this is like those puzzle solving games with the mom and kid freezing to death and you gotta help them... it's not the full game.

Geesh! It's one of these games! As soon as you open the game up they send you numerous pop ups trying to milk you of your money. Guess what! The game is fun! Only if you spend "a lot of money "! Most players seem to build up the fastest they can then sell the game to other players. So unless you like dumping "a lot" of money into a game stay clear of this $$$ money pit! Start a new hobby or even buy a new car! 😅 really though don't waste your time with their greed!

Another bait and switch. The ads show a game where you can build survival homes, and even advertises as such with a description. But when you install, it's another sufferable base-building game that is more "tutorial" than game play. Also, nice gaslighting in the replies to similar complaints. "Intended to show post-apocalyptic" then do it honestly as a base-building game ad. Pretty slimy and dishonest.

Customer support doesn't work at all. We have a player on our server that is harassing female players constantly. We have some minors in the game! There were multiple reports, I have already sent an email with screenshot evidence, but instead of limiting the player on the level of email, they accidentally muted me and that was all reaction. A lot of active players are very unhappy with this approach.

I've played every single day since the first day on Server 173, but now I'm done with this game. The developers have become increasingly greedy, constantly experimenting with monthly events and making them worse. The recent Love Unlocked event is taking the game in a strange direction it feels more like a dating app than an actual game now. There are way too many events, especially over the weekends, almost as if the developers don’t want players to spend time doing anything else other than game

Predatory Money Grab. I have spent $110 on this game in 1 month so I can access special characters and weapons so I can level up in the game. The game wants you to spend more money so you can have more trucks moving supplies and researching different categories to level up. Again, I have spent $110 on this game in October and today I see that they removed my ability to research 2 things at once. the other day they also took away 1 of my 4 trucks to move supplies. Are you freaking serious?!

I believe the game and its developers should implement a notification system for players. I only received notifications when I opened the game, and once I entered, I suddenly found over 20 notifications waiting for me. By then, my base had already been destroyed after five months of progress. While my overall experience was enjoyable, I think I’ll be looking for better games.

First, it's NOTHING like the ads. This looked like it was going to be the best zombie survival game ever annnd then you download it to find it's the worst zombie survival game ever. Graphics are awful. The story is...well... let's start with zombies being afraid of all light, including the sun. The voices are all loud and overdramatic. They're all yelling all the time. They think we're too stupid to tap on the quests and so force you to do it their way. Beyond ridiculous. Recommended? Fork NO!

Not worth the time and effort. This would be a really good game if it wasn't like a ton of other games that allow for the constant attacks by more powerful players.Shields can be used if you have them but if not you get burned constantly. So if you like all the time and effort you put into building your settlement just to have a lot of resources and the time you put into development taken by those more powerful then this is the game for you. Of course you can always spend tons of $$ to keep up.

Easy to learn. There are lots of side missions to help upgrade heroes. No annoying ads, which is huge for me. Great job, developers. I think im going to enjoy your game. well, it was fun while it lasted, but after the last few updates, the game started lagging and freezing. the new season is confusing and drained all the fun out of the game. I deleted it and am moving on.

Game appears to be reskinned clone of a cold based base builder. Not a big deal. my issue is the images in the play store show some really sick looking underground vault style bases or futuristic bases in run down city's city's after the world's end. none of those represent the game which has a cartoony look and is really just building a base around a bonfire to keep the zombies away. I can support a game that misleads people into thinking it's going to be something different than what it is.

would be 0 stars if that was an option... couldn't even get the game to load. It just sat at 50% and kept telling me there was a network error... no, there's not. Same WiFi I'm using to watch TV right now issue free. reading other reviews, it appears this game is nothing like the ads, and I didn’t want another expensive upgrade survival game like those blizzard ones. Uninstalled.

Very few games match the "Advertising". I originally gave 5***** but now only 3*** because of the False Advertising. Still the game is easy to play, keep updating everything equally, and explore. Best to update your big building when taking a break from the game, because they will finish for you. I like this game. But don't expect an aircraft carrier to be your home, that has not happened to me or anyone I know.

I like the game a lot. I enjoy upgrading the camp and Heroes. However the game is not as advertised which I don't understand. Update: Downgrade to two stars. It still is an okay game however they push packages on you to purchase. I have purchased a few in support of the game and you can progress without spending money however it is a grind. I wish this game was as advertised.

Been playing this game for about 2 months. It's a pay-to-win game, nothing wrong with that but just know what u are getting into. Advertisements show fighting zombies but in reality after reaching a certain level it's really more PvP. Not so bad if u are in a good server and good alliance, but this is essentially reflective of the real world, with spies planted to creat conflict and increase revenue.

It needs a lot of improvements. In the game, there's no Support system or GM to talk with, no FAQ, no How to Play basic-info, and, I got stuck in my secondary email for purchasing which I didn't sign it up for the game account, and I can't change the email to be released out of the game. I guess it's a sign for me not to purchase anything in the game

Worst game ever! Super slow. You can't skip through the dialogue be cause that's all it is. You would think the tutorial assistance would stop after a certain point but it doesn't. You can only do what the game is telling you to do every step of the way and the game is 85% dialogue and 15% pushing only the buttons that the game tells you to push. So f#@'n stupid...

Absolutely nothing like the ads. I don't know why people are forgiving the fact that this game is absolutely nothing like what you see all over the internet. There's nothing pixelated about this game, it's just a standard zombie role-playing game where you update your buildings and characters. The game developer claims you can see the art style from ads in the memories of people in your camp. All I saw were pictures that kind of looked like the ads. Really, this is a pretty standard boring game.

The worst game of this type. I've played a few similar games, but none of them put so much emphasis on spending money. Here, after a very short period of time, they will simply take away your ability to perform regular daily activities without spending any money. In battle passes you get complete garbage for free, you can only get one gold character for free, and for the rest you have to pay a lot of money. It's just a game where most of the events are "spend your money or we'll give you scrap"

1. Endless pay-to-win with overpriced packs in every event. 2. Frequent bugs disrupting key gameplay. 3. Repetitive events with almost no difference between seasons. 4. Lack of genuine strategy and no continuous tutorials. 5. Whales dominate through threats, punishments, and self-made rules. 6. No discounts and no option to transfer accounts. 7. Very limited migration options. Not sure if there is anything valuable you'll learn by playing this game.

The game is fine. The same as other colony builders. But the images used are completely, utterly fake. There's no underground building. It's all relatively simply cartoony buildings and characters. It's also one of those games where when you reach a certain level other players will just attack you and there's no way to opt out.

The same thing others have said: the images on the front page are not at all what the game actually is; they are a complete farce. The tags are also inaccurate or plain wrong: it is neither a survival nor a single-player game. Though it does utilize a different theme, this game is nearly identical to some other games. This is truly just a money-grab from an untrustworthy developer.

SAME GAME, DIFFERENT NAME-BUT I LOVE IT I have played a few very similar games over the years. Alliances, towers, troops, upgrade, build, tech, zombies, events, war, strategy, 24/7. There a few features this game didn't have, that some others do. You can't share RSS with another player. You can't move an entire alliance to a new server, or your own player. Some resources are either available only in rare events, or did purchase. And once again, strongest players are the ones who payto play.

Overall good. Needs localization so you can understand the heroes, or at least subtitles, am i right? Differentiate from music and sound effects so you can turn them both on or off. It has an attractive interface with interesting heroes. Some are VERY similar looking, but that's okay in my opinion.
